note: Verso body page with a margin figure. Two columns: a narrow left margin column (0.13-0.42) holding Fig. 1.26 and its caption, and the body column on the right (0.313-0.905). The body column's first few lines (blocks 2-5) are indented to x~0.44 to clear the margin figure, then run the full measure from x~0.313 once the figure ends at y~0.26; that indent is text wrap inside the right column, not a third column. Blocks were matched by position and all 15 matched one-to-one, corroborated by kind and text_head: figure->1, then the alternating equation/paragraph run 2-6, prose 7-11, equation 12, prose 13-14, list 15. The figure's caption is reported as a separate figure_caption element with n=null because A2 emitted only one figure block (n=1, empty text_head), which I assigned to the graphic itself. body_text_size_px measured on the justified body prose in the right column and is given in the original image's pixels (1700x2178). Align omitted on all equations: their left starts differ (x~0.47 for blocks 2/4/6, x~0.343 for block 12), so I could not tell centred from fixed-indent. The dark grey rule at y~0.122 is the underline of the grey 'Physics' header box and is included inside that running_header element's bbox rather than reported as a separate rule_bar. The foot line '2022-23' has no footer role in the allowed list, so it is reported as running_header; there is no footer_rule on this page. Fills sampled from flat interiors: top band #b5e2f6, header box #c8c8c8, page-number box #cdeaf8.
